source_name: CBCG — Mapa sajta (site map)
why_relevant: Full enumeration of the CBCG site tree. The site uses multiple interchangeable path prefixes (/me/, /r/, /c/, /public/, and odd legacy prefixes), so the sitemap is the safest way to enumerate canonical statistics URLs and detect page moves rather than treating a 404 as a dead source.

source_name: CBCG — Registri: platni sistemi, platne institucije i agenti, institucije elektronskog novca
why_relevant: Official registers of licensed payment systems, payment institutions and their agents. These enumerate the actor universe (who must report the payment/card statistics) and are the canonical snowball list for A4 actor mapping in Montenegro.

source_name: MONSTAT — publications index (Uprava za statistiku Crne Gore)
why_relevant: Master index of Montenegrin official statistics releases; the discovery layer for tourism arrivals, retail turnover and remittance-adjacent series that drive seasonal cash demand in a euroised, tourism-heavy economy.

source_name: UBCG — Članice udruženja (member bank list)
why_relevant: Enumerates all 11 licensed banks with their own websites (Addiko, Adriatic, CKB, Erste, Hipotekarna, NLB, Lovćen, Prva banka, Universal Capital, Zapad banka, Ziraat) — the seed list for bank-level disclosure cells (card portfolios, ATM/POS networks, fee tariffs).

source_name: Udruzenje banaka Crne Gore (UBCG) - ubcg.info
why_relevant: The ME banks' association: member list, seminars/education calendar, statements and event coverage. Serves as the actor map for the banking side of the cell and as an announcement channel for sector conferences and training on payments and cards.

source_name: UBCG — Propisi (regulations collection)
why_relevant: Association-curated set of banking/payment regulations; a shortcut map to which laws and CBCG decisions the industry considers binding on payment services, and a pointer into the legal-source cells.

source_name: Bankar.me — bank branch & ATM locator page
why_relevant: A media-maintained directory pointing to every Montenegrin bank's branch and ATM location pages. Useful as a pointer/actor map for ATM-network footprint work rather than as a statistics source itself.

source_name: Asseco Case Study Book — Payment chapter
why_relevant: Curated Asseco group case-study repository organised by domain; payment chapter entries identify named client banks and the scale of deployments (terminal/ATM counts, processing volumes) across SEE including ME. Case studies frequently disclose estate sizes that banks themselves never publish.

source_name: CompanyWall Montenegro — bank company financial profiles
why_relevant: Commercial registry aggregator carrying revenue, headcount and filing metadata per bank legal entity; useful to date filings and to catch entities whose own sites publish little (e.g. Ziraat, Universal Capital, Zapad).

source_name: EU4ME / eu.me — Montenegrin Government EU-integration portal, Chapter 4 page
why_relevant: Official Montenegrin-language pointer hub: names the negotiating working group (led by CBCG), lists chapter documents, national programmes and legislative milestones (e.g. Zakon o platnom prometu amendments aligned with PSD2). Excellent snowball node into government PDFs.

source_name: TheBanks.eu — Montenegro bank profiles (Lovćen, Universal Capital, etc.)
why_relevant: English-language normalized profiles giving assets, market share and rank per ME bank; convenient for sizing/weighting banks before deciding which annual reports to mine.

source_name: UCG institutional repository / 'skladiste' document store (theses and dissertations)
why_relevant: University of Montenegro hosts full-text doctoral dissertations and master theses as PDFs under /skladiste/. Confirmed to host at least one banking/finance dissertation (Đurović, on national development and financial institutions). Theses frequently contain original merchant/consumer surveys and reconstructed card/POS series unavailable elsewhere.

source_name: Global Public Procurement Database (GPPD) - Montenegro country profile
why_relevant: World Bank-hosted profile describing the ME procurement legal framework, systems and data availability; useful for judging how complete and machine-readable ME tender data is before building a collector, and for locating the authoritative data endpoints.

source_name: ICT Cortex - ME ICT cluster (fintech/banking technology commentary and events)
why_relevant: Cluster of Montenegrin ICT companies (including firms supplying banks). Member profiles, project write-ups and event pages reveal which local integrators build payment/card/ATM solutions for ME banks - supplier-side intelligence unavailable from procurement records for private banks.

source_name: Interbalkan Forum of Banking Associations (IFBA)
why_relevant: UBCG is a full member; the forum's meetings gather regional banking associations and produce country presentations that often include payment/card sector snapshots, and it points to peer associations for cross-country benchmarking.

source_name: Media Ownership Monitor Montenegro
why_relevant: Independent register of Montenegrin media outlets with ownership, reach and financing profiles. Essential for scoring the credibility and independence of each media source in this cell (e.g. state vs private ownership of Pobjeda vs Vijesti) and for discovering outlets not yet on the list.

entity_name: Montenegrin merchant checkout / payment-conditions pages naming gateway + acquirer
source_name: Montenegrin merchant checkout / payment-conditions pages naming gateway + acquirer
why_relevant: ME merchants are contractually obliged to disclose their card-processing chain on checkout/payment-terms pages, e.g. 'card payments realised in cooperation with AllSecure d.o.o. and Hipotekarna banka'. Systematically harvesting these boilerplate disclosures across ME merchant sites yields a bottom-up map of e-commerce acquirer and gateway market share that no regulator publishes.

source_name: Privredna komora Crne Gore - Odbor udruzenja bankarstva i drugih finansijskih organizacija i osiguranja
why_relevant: Chamber of Commerce banking committee: publishes session agendas, minutes, position papers and event announcements naming member institutions. A reliable pointer to sector working groups, upcoming regulatory changes affecting payments, and to further events and actors.

source_name: UDG — Univerzitet Donja Gorica, FIST / economics-finance faculties
why_relevant: Montenegro's main private university, with international-economics/finance and information-systems faculties (FIST) that supervise master theses on digital banking and payments; thesis rules and some works are posted on faculty subdomains.

source_name: Wikipedia — List of banks in Montenegro (actor map seed)
why_relevant: Quick bilingual actor map with ownership/parent-group mapping (OTP, NLB, Erste, Ziraat) that tells you which foreign parent annual reports also segment Montenegro. Must be validated against the CBCG register.
